_comment: Brains4Buildings Windesheim: the same rooms as b4b_bms.json, but with the room's second CO2 sensor -- the desk-mounted SCD41 measurement device (CO2-meter-SCD4x_co2__ppm, 10-minute, baseline-shifted by the publisher like the BMS sensor) -- as the demand signal, so the DCV verdict can be compared across the two sensors of one room (equipment ROOM_<id>_scd41). Valve and PIR occupancy are the BMS columns as in b4b_bms.json (no outdoor temperature, for the same reason); the SCD41's own temperature (about 2.2 degC below the BMS reading) is not mapped.
